test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question: According to the Indian Constitution, at one time, a person can be the Governor of a maximum number of how many State/States?

options.text: The maximum number is not fixed

solution:
The correct answer is __**The maximum number is not fixed**__.

__
 
• **According to the Indian Constitution, at one time, a person can be the Governor of a maximum of any number of states, the maximum number is not fixed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The office of the Governor is the highest office in the state.**
 
• The Governor is also called the first-person of the state.
 
• The Governor is appointed and removed by the President of India.
 
• Governor holds the office till the President of India.
 
• **Condition for the office of the governor:**
 
 
• He should be an Indian Citizen.
 
• He should be 35 years old or more.
 
• He should not hold any office of profit.
 
• He cannot be a member of parliament or state legislature.
